description: arXiv:2502.20295v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Handwriting text recognition (HTR) remains a challenging task. Existing approaches require fine-tuning on labeled data, which is impractical to obtain for real-world problems, or rely on zero-shot tools such as OCR engines and multi-modal LLMs (MLLMs). MLLMs have shown promise both as end-to-end transcribers and as OCR post-processors, b...
